output.summary: The 98.1% figure is produced by a metric dispatchers control. Revisions replace the original date, and revision rates rose about fivefold. They jumped at each center exactly when the bonus took effect (Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July). Revisions are now mostly "Operational - Capacity", entered late and rarely notified. RouteWise went live at Northgate in October, after its jump, so it does not explain the rise. Brightwell's receiving logs show on-time falling from 87% to 81%, and lateness complaints rose 35% while damage and billing complaints stayed flat, which argues against a portal artifact. Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus. Recompute against original dates and re-base the incentive. The driver shortage is plausible but unproven, so a $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
